messages:
provisioner-bot: [ALERT] hosted-provisioner failed to allocate GPU instances in us-east-1: quotaExceeded. queue_length=420, in_flight=320, p95=0.82s, p99=6.2s
ops-oncall: paging sre-eli and runtime-ana. high customer impact, timeouts reported. :rotating_light:
sre-eli: oncall here, looking. linking logs...
runtime-ana: saw a jump in small-model traffic + a marketing campaign 15m ago. possible thundering herd on the hosted pool.
infra-miguel: checking cloud console, instance create API returning 403 QuotaExceeded: "GPUs per project". requesting quota increase shows pending.
sre-eli: confirmed. autoscaler is trying to create nodes but cloud rejects. provisioner shows repeated create attempts and backoff.
ops-oncall: impact: p99 degraded, several customers with timeouts. cs-rahul please gather any customer escalations. product-lena FYI.
cs-rahul: getting 3 tickets from two customers on hosted API timeouts, one on embeddings. notifying customers now with ETA placeholder.
runtime-ana: can we failover to dedicated pools or smaller quantized variants?
infra-miguel: we have limited spare in eu-west but cross-region fallback needs routing config and may add latency.
sre-eli: quick mitigations: 1) enable aggressive request-shedding for low-priority keys 2) fallback routing to eu-west 3) temporarily allow smaller quantized model for embeddings 4) pause non-essential background jobs. I'll push runbook steps.
ops-oncall: do it. prep a rollback path.
sre-eli: running commands:
```
# mark keys for shed
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://admin.redwood/api/shed -d '{"policy":"low_priority","ratio":0.6}'
# enable model fallback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://admin.redwood/api/routing -d '{"from":"gpt-thumb-1","to":"gpt-thumb-1-quant","threshold_ms":250}'
```
runtime-ana: started fallback config, logs show immediate drop in queue for embeddings route. p95 down to 320ms, p99 now 1.8s (was 6.2s).
infra-miguel: requested emergency quota bump via cloud support (ticket #CS-9921). ETA unknown. Opening support chat.
customer-alert-bot: Sent generic incident update to customers with affected keys. Message id: 3245.
product-lena: good call on quantized fallback. track quality regressions but customers need availability first.
cs-rahul: notified 2 high-touch customers directly, offering workaround: pin to dedicated for critical traffic.
sre-eli: manual scale attempt still failing due to quota. provisioner logs:
```
ERROR: CreateInstance failed: QuotaExceeded: requested 8 GPUs, available 0
attempt=12 backoff=30s
```
ops-oncall: what's the live backlog now?
runtime-ana: queue_length=120 after mitigations (from 420). error rate dropped from 6% to 1.1%. p99 stabilizing ~1.5s.
infra-miguel: cloud support acknowledged ticket, but said manual quota increase may take 2-3 hours unless approved. I'll escalate to account manager.
ops-oncall: escalate now. product-lena: start a postmortem stub and collect timeline.
sre-eli: leaving a note: root cause appears to be sudden spike + exhausted GPU quota in primary region + autoscaler retries hitting quota limit and backing off. secondary failure: no fast automatic cross-region failover for some routes.
customer-alert-bot: Sent second customer update: mitigation in progress, temporary degradation, recommended workarounds.
infra-miguel: account manager on call, pushing priority. Cloud support offered a hotfix to increase quota for 1 hour while they review. Awaiting confirmation.
ops-oncall: if cloud gives temp quota, we'll allow autoscaler to replenish, else we maintain fallbacks. Keep communications tight.
runtime-ana: note to engineering: consider lowering bump thresholds and adding immediate cross-region failover for host model variants.
product-lena: will coordinate product-side communications and CS scripts for affected customers.
cs-rahul: customers accepted workaround for now. one customer requested credit; logged.
provisioner-bot: [UPDATE] cloud support temporarily increased GPU quota in us-east-1 by +20 GPUs for 1 hour. Provisioner will retry.
sre-eli: re-enabling autoscaler create attempts.
provisioner-bot: provisioner created 18 nodes, in_flight back to normal, queue draining. p95 220ms, p99 480ms.
ops-oncall: monitoring for 30 more minutes, then handoff to afternoon oncall. Good work. :thumbsup:
product-lena: filing follow-up: add runbook steps for quota-exhaustion, preemptive quota checks during campaigns, and add routing rules for faster cross-region failover.
infra-miguel: will run an inventory of quota buffers per region and propose safe minimums.
sre-eli: postmortem assigned to infra-miguel + runtime-ana. ETA for initial draft: EOD.
cs-rahul: updating customers with final mitigations and next steps.
ops-oncall: incident closed (informational) pending postmortem. Last metrics: queue_length=12, p95=210ms, p99=430ms.
